name: giga-stream
description: Giga Stream: the interface (src/frontend), the fileserver and Electron host (src/fileserver) and the admin backend (src/backend). See docs/00.

scripts.dev: npm run kill-ports && npm run fixtures && concurrently --kill-others --names backend,admin,frontend,electron --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:stack --prefix src/backend" "npm run dev --prefix src/admin" "npm run dev --prefix src/frontend" "npm run dev --prefix src/fileserver"
scripts.dist:win: npm run build --prefix src/frontend && npm run build --prefix src/fileserver && electron-builder --win --config electron-builder.config.cjs
